payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Carina, Clarinda, Ivette, Shonna

payload.content: Hello team, Ivette here. I am considering taking a task that fits well with my skills in infrastructure and documentation, while keeping my availability of 4 hours in mind. I see some medium priority tasks related to infrastructure and critical priority tasks related to documentation. Let's coordinate to avoid overlaps and maximize our sprint output. If anyone else is eyeing the critical documentation tasks, please let me know so we can strategize accordingly.

Ivette, I am looking at medium priority infrastructure tasks due to my skills and availability. If you want to take some documentation critical tasks, that might be more suitable for you. Let's avoid overlapping on the critical documentation tasks so we all get the best out of this sprint.

Ivette, Clarinda and I are coordinating to maximize sprint output. Clarinda plans to take a medium priority infrastructure task 'ISSUE-0001::triage', and I will take a critical documentation task, likely 'ISSUE-0002::review'. This should help avoid overlaps and optimize task distribution.

Hello team, Shonna here. I have strong skills in machine-learning and availability of 7 hours. I see Clarinda plans to take 'ISSUE-0001::triage' (medium priority infrastructure), Carina will take 'ISSUE-0002::review' (critical documentation). I am considering taking 'ISSUE-0001::implement' or 'ISSUE-0001::review' to complement your picks and avoid overlap. Please share if you have other plans or preferences for infrastructure tasks.

Hi all, Shonna here. I have good machine-learning skills and can take on medium priority tasks related to machine-learning within 7 hours availability. I see infrastructure and documentation tasks are being coordinated by others. I am leaning towards 'ISSUE-0001::implement' or 'ISSUE-0001::review' to maximize output without overlaps. Feedback welcome.

Shonna here. To summarize: Clarinda will take ISSUE-0001::triage (medium priority infrastructure), Carina will take ISSUE-0002::review (critical documentation). I propose taking ISSUE-0001::implement (medium priority machine-learning) to complement these choices and maximize task coverage. Please confirm or suggest any adjustments.

Hello all, Ivette here. I see Clarinda will take ISSUE-0001::triage and Carina will take ISSUE-0002::review, with Shonna leaning towards ISSUE-0001::implement. Given my skills and availability, I am considering taking ISSUE-0001::docs as it aligns well with my documentation skill and 2.0 effort fits my 4 hours availability. This way, we cover multiple important tasks without overlap. Thoughts?

Ivette suggests taking ISSUE-0001::docs for its good skill fit and effort within availability, complementing Clarinda's, Carina's, and Shonna's intended picks. Let's confirm task choices for optimized sprint output.

Ivette here. I am open to feedback on my proposed task ISSUE-0001::docs. If anyone has suggestions or wants to coordinate further for best task distribution, please share. Looking forward to finalizing our sprint tasks soon.

Ivette, Shonna, I am planning to take the medium priority infrastructure task ISSUE-0001::triage. Carina will handle one of the critical documentation tasks. Let's coordinate to avoid overlap and maximize sprint output for everyone.

Clarinda and I have agreed on a plan: Clarinda will take ISSUE-0001::triage (medium priority infrastructure) and I will take ISSUE-0002::review (critical documentation). This coordination aims to maximize our sprint output and avoid overlaps. Please consider this in your planning.

Clarinda and I have agreed on a plan: Clarinda will take ISSUE-0001::triage (medium priority infrastructure) and I will take ISSUE-0002::review (critical documentation). This coordination aims to maximize our sprint output and avoid overlaps. Please consider this in your planning.

Hello team, Shonna here. I support the current coordination plan: Clarinda on ISSUE-0001::triage, Carina on ISSUE-0002::review, Ivette on ISSUE-0001::docs, and I will take ISSUE-0001::implement. This distribution aligns well with our skills, availability, and task priorities, maximizing our sprint output without overlaps. Looking forward to finalizing this plan.
